messages:
sarah: CI on main red after last night's secret rotation — failing at secrets fetch step, looks like a KMS decrypt error, can someone triage?
ci-bot: Workflow: build-and-test (main) failed - job 'integration-tests' - exit code 1
ci-bot: Error: KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-efgh (see logs)
kevin: I rotated the repo AWS creds secret last night when I updated the key alias. Did we forget to update the runner role/key policy? :grimacing:
maria: I updated the repo secret in GH but I didn't update the KMS key policy for the runner role — my bad, I thought TF would handle it automatically.
devon: Can someone rerun with a fallback env var? I pushed an org secret redwood-ci-fallback-key that points to a different key but runners might not have access. If we can set FORCE_FALLBACK_KEY=1 for the workflow we can test.
sarah: Rerun requested, but I don't have permission to flip org secrets on the workflow. @kevin any ETA on key policy update?
ops-bot: Permission check: runner-role-redwood (arn:aws:iam::111111:role/runner-role-redwood) missing kms:Decrypt on key alias/redwood/ci — automated request to infra owners created.
kevin: Granting now. Adding kms:Decrypt to runner-role-redwood on alias/redwood/ci. Applying Terraform in ~2m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 (will update when done)
maria: If TF gets stuck, quick bisect: can someone run the failing workflow on the previous green SHA (abcdef0) and then on HEAD to confirm it's permission-related and not a code change?
sarah: Manual rerun just now still shows decrypt error across multiple runners. Not a single-run flake.
devon: Log snippet from the runner when it tries to decrypt the token:
```
$ aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://token.enc --region us-west-2
Error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/runner-role-redwood is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-efgh
```
kevin: TF apply finished. Key policy updated to allow runner-role-redwood kms:Decrypt. Please try rerun.
sarah: Reran — checkout passed but now GH returned 403 when fetching org secret (secrets API). Looks like the org secret was set to 'Selected repositories' and this repo wasn't added.
maria: Yup, my change set the secret to selected repos and I missed this repo. Adding the repo to the org secret ACL now.
devon: If adding the repo takes longer, we can temporarily open the org secret to all repos for a quick green run, then restrict again. ping if you want me to do that. :lock_with_key:
sarah: OK rerun after both fixes — build is green! :tada: Summary: root cause was secret rotation + missing key policy update + repo not whitelisted for org secret. Fixes: update KMS key policy (kevin), add repo to org secret ACL (maria).
kevin: I'll leave the infra PR open with the change and add a short doc in infra/ops about rotating creds and the checklist for repo-level access.
sarah: Thanks all — closing the incident and will follow up in the infra channel with the postmortem checklist.
maria: Sorry for the churn, will add an automated test for secret access during rotation flows.
devon: Nice coord, nice quick bisect / rollback plan. :thumbsup:
